screening_method_note: PASS -- SD29-E5-F2-010 (monster lane), 2026-08-15T02:34:27Z: every field of the 116 records this run wrote (39 monsters + 77 monster abilities) was screened against the bounded, documented term list in docs/governance/ogl-pi-blacklist.md, zero hits. A hit is a hard stop in this generator, not a warning. Updated by SD31-E6-F10-001 (2026-08-17): the spell lane (`ingest_inner_sea_gods_spells.rs` + `cache_gen::spell_lane_dump` + `enrich_spell_raw_tokens.rs`) added 92 more records (of 96 real base declarations). `isg_spells.lst` declares zero `NAMEISPI:`/`DESCISPI:` tokens at all, so every one of the 4 dropped records (`Abadar's Truthtelling`, `Gozreh's Trident`, `Rovagug's Fury`, `Sympathy (Shelynite)`) was caught by the §52.3 blacklist scan alone -- the §53.5 declared-PI reader ran on every record and found nothing to read, not a second independent catch (corrected 2026-08-17, SD31-W9-INTEGRATE-001: the prior wording, "each caught independently by both screens," was false for a book with no declared-PI tokens). Both SD-30 PI contracts are still applied per record to NAME, DESCRIPTION and every `raw_tokens` field independently (not only NAME/DESCRIPTION -- a real `FACTSET:Deity|<name>` token redacts even when the description itself is clean). records_processed is now 208 (116 + 92): the real on-disk count for this book across every kind any lane has ingested (`find data/corpus/inner_sea_gods -name '*.json' ! -name LICENSE.json | wc -l`). records_redacted is 5 (corrected 2026-08-17, SD31-W9-INTEGRATE-001, was 4): every shipped spell record whose DESCRIPTION itself was redacted for a blacklist hit (`license == "PI-REDACTED"`), re-derived directly from the shipped records after fixing a real PI exposure this integration cycle found and closed -- `isg_spells.lst:46`'s `FACTSET:Deity|Cayden CaiLean` (the oracle's own miscapitalized spelling) and `isg_spells.lst:8`'s DESC use of "lrori" (the oracle's own OCR of "Irori") both survived the exact-substring blacklist scan unredacted because neither term's exact-cased/exact-spelled form was on the list; both are now covered (`pi_screening::PI_BLACKLIST_TERMS`) and re-screened clean on disk. This is separate from, and undercounts, the 51 further shipped records carrying a redacted non-DESCRIPTION `raw_tokens` field (mostly `FACTSET`) whose top-level `license` correctly stays `OGL` because their DESCRIPTION field itself is clean -- `records_redacted` tracks description-level redactions only, matching its own field name; the token-level population is not separately fielded here. This is NOT an exhaustive human legal review; it is a bounded substring scan and does not prove the absence of PI beyond what that scan can see. UPDATE -- SD31-E6-F10-004 (equipment gap lane), 2026-08-17: `gen_equipment_gap_tables`/`gen_cache_equipment_gap` added this book's first equipment/equipment_modifier records (125) via the corpus gap lane -- `isg_equip.lst`'s 2 `NAMEISPI:YES` rows (`Altar of Desna`, `Altar of Erastil`) were excluded whole before ever reaching the gap table (declared-PI reader), and a new per-record blacklist pre-filter (`gen_equipment_gap_tables.rs`'s `blacklist_hit`, `OPEN-ISSUES.md` row 186's own named follow-on) redacts a bare deity/place mention in undeclared free-text prose instead of hard-stopping the whole book. Every one of the 125 shipped equipment records was independently re-screened via `pi_screening::classify_field`/`classify_optional_field_declared` at JSON-write time (`gen_cache_equipment_gap`); 0 carry `license == "PI-REDACTED"` at that time (re-derived: `grep -rl PI-REDACTED data/corpus/inner_sea_gods/equipment/ | wc -l` -> 0 as shipped). records_processed restated 208 -> 333 (208 + 125), records_redacted unchanged at 5 (re-derived corpus-wide, unaffected by this update). UPDATE -- SD31-W12-INTEGRATE-001 (2026-08-17): fixed a confirmed PI exposure the equipment gap lane's own separate `enrich_equipment_raw_tokens.rs` pass introduced downstream of the write above -- that enricher populates `raw_tokens` from the raw `.lst` line directly, with NO screening of its own, so 28 of these 125 equipment records shipped a blacklisted deity/place name verbatim in `raw_tokens` (e.g. `cloak_of_the_night_sky.json`'s `DESC`/`SPELLS` tokens naming "Desna") while `description` was already correctly redacted by `gen_equipment_gap_tables.rs`'s per-record blacklist screen -- the description redaction and the record's own `license`/`pi_field`/`pi_marker` metadata had drifted apart because the description-level screen runs INSIDE the compiled table, before `gen_cache_equipment_gap`'s otherwise-correct classify step ever sees the un-redacted text (it sees only the already-blanked marker and reads that as clean). Both are now fixed: `enrich_equipment_raw_tokens.rs` screens every `raw_tokens`/`raw_bonus_chains` value it writes (SD-30 §52.3/§53.5), and these 28 records' `license`/`pi_field`/`pi_marker` were corrected in place from `"OGL"`/`null`/`null` to `"PI-REDACTED"`/`"description"`/`"redacted"`, matching their already-redacted `description` field. records_redacted restated 5 -> 33 (5 + 28, `grep -rl 'PI-REDACTED' data/corpus/inner_sea_gods/equipment/*.json | wc -l` -> 28 as of this fix). The deeper generator-layering root cause (blacklist redaction happening before the downstream license-classification step can see the un-redacted text) is NOT fixed at the root this cycle -- documented in OPEN-ISSUES as a follow-up for the next equipment-owning cycle rather than risking a wholesale regen under time pressure.
